source: spec 13, J.6 balance sims and loop delay tests

bands.meaning: wars break out, but the world is not at war with itself every epoch
mortals neither die as children nor outlive their lifespans en masse; the ceiling leaves room for notable, medicine and long-lived house lifespans
the maimed are visible but do not become the majority

once a world's first institutions have formed, measured over the second half of a run, communities neither collapse nor multiply without bound; a young world still settles its rural folk into villages, which now survive their first epoch
hatred exists but most pairs are not blood enemies
the doom clock creeps rather than races
realms hold a few policies on numbers at most, never a pile of them
outlets keep some trust overall; exposure does not drive every one of them to nothing
towns keep shops in proportion, not without bound
some works fail, but most are built or still building
households take on help when burdened without filling with servants
kin groups split when too large but do not multiply without bound
folk knowledge errs, but most classes are not wrong
peoples hold a handful of customs of restraint at most
ways of teaching follow the schools a people has
endowments are founded, captured and spent, not heaped without end
youth groups stay groups and split or disband rather than swallow towns
a people keeps its roles of death work, never more than its kinds of role
speeches are given, but the world does not talk without end
fields and air shield most worlds from most of their star's weather
harbours silt, but dredging and currents keep most coasts open
cures are overused in places without every disease resisting every cure
bodies fail where worlds are past bearing, not everywhere
every plant has a body of a few parts
beds of remains are laid by what died out, not in every land without end
weather works are rare enough that most lands keep their own sky
some who profess a value are shown to act against it, not most
each realm keeps an order of its economy, and a few name orders for their sectors; none drowns in orders
organisations gain governing bodies as they grow; the share can never pass every living organisation
compacts form where few sellers meet, never more than one to a market
worker bodies strike and are locked out at times, not in every town every epoch
a realm that issues money keeps at most a couple of authorities over its currencies
listed claims are held by a handful to a crowd of holders, never by the whole world
realms gather into leagues, but leagues stay fewer than the realms that fill them
settlements of one land grow together into cities now and then; most towns stay their own
some lands are set under protection, never most of the world
holders leave their offices by their own choice now and then; offices do not empty every season
the people are asked where their law allows it, rarely in pre-modern worlds
a fallen regime is reckoned with only after it falls
cults of living leaders arise in some realms, never several to a realm
movements to raise a fallen realm again are rare
occupied lands are ruled by a regime while they are held
weapons of mass harm stay few and need modern means
hosts cross between worlds only where ways and means allow
families keep favour, rivalry and casting out within bounds
places and households carry a shared mood, not an endless pile of them
interpreters err or slant some exchanges, never most of them
some furnished graves are robbed; most are left in peace or guarded
bodies wear by age, diet and strain; most mortals carry a condition or two at most
peoples know a few means to prevent, seek or end conception
honours are conferred on a minority of the living
great waves strike seldom, after quakes, slides and storms
wild kinds gather into a few groups to a land, not a swarm in every valley
each faith holds one conception of the divine

record_bands.run: scripts/record_bands.py <copy of a lived world> --epochs 1 (LLM-free; the world is copied with sqlite backup and never touched)

baseline.world: the live world at epoch 53 before W49 (c597ecad)

bands.meaning: the record keeps at least what it kept before W49 and grows by at most a hundred times, every incident, fact, step, state, term, change and line included
every number the engine changes says why: its terms, or a kind that sets it outright
every happening whose kind needs a place has one
recording every happening and change adds at most a third to the epoch time measured before W49, kept by batching at flush
